text: Well-funded city watch; it keeps order reliably and is growing more sure of its own authority.
why: calls the city watch 'well-funded'; the defence page says garrison and watch are resource-constrained, inadequate equipment, irregular pay

fold: They have stopped believing, have told no #, and still lead the prayers every week.
text: They have stopped believing, have told no one, and still lead the prayers every week.
why: Aleidis Krause is the militia captain, not clergy; the priest is Norbert Krause, so 'still lead the prayers every week' does not fit her

fold: Wants Learn whether <N> can still pay what is owed.
text: Wants Learn whether Tserenpuntsag Qonggirad can still pay what is owed.
why: priest wants to learn whether Tserenpuntsag can still pay what is owed, but the debt runs the other way: Zümür Merkit owes Tserenpuntsag
